description: An NVDA screen reader add-on that allows you to quickly get the current prayer times for Muslims anywhere on Earth.
changelog:
* Correct date, time zone, next-day Fajr and Isha after midnight
* Select calculation method, Asr school, high latitude adjustment and 12/24-hour display
* Use HTTPS and timeouts; validate coordinates and discard outdated requests
* Cache daily data by location and calculation settings
* Complete Turkish translation and add Turkish help
* Include portable time zone data and focused regression tests

translations.description: Konuma ve seçilen hesaplama yöntemine göre namaz vakitlerini gösterir. NVDA+Alt+P tüm vakitleri, NVDA+Shift+P sıradaki namazı bildirir.
